display_name: 独立频域时域恢复网络逐场景源域筛选
description: 固定完整源训练最终权重，按预声明标准以 DURA 为对照做源域逐场景筛选和 RX8 留出观察。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU0 single process; CPU 2 threads; TF32 disabled; fixed-checkpoint source action matrix reference smoke

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256]; input-only complex spectral and temporal direct network with input protection gate; DURA benchmark only
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX labels, U_s truth, V or test read; F clean pseudo targets for source evaluation
data.validation_ref: 7840 RX4/6 source training-role heldout records for selection, 3921 RX8 exploratory heldout; physical IDs were observed in prior channel views

permissions.query_use: Source-only pilot with RX8 source holdout; no target IQ, V, or truth
permissions.claim_scope: Single seed source-only diagnostic; no independent blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed direct spectral source epoch03 checkpoint; SHA recorded at runtime; frozen F and input gate, DURA comparator only.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Direct source training commit 79053b41ca9d349b267c8c06b7b4655de8dc7769, fixed final checkpoint and complete result verified at runtime; source selection rules pinned 86acfb414d70c638ef086e318739cc158a9b6601.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: RX4/6 each receiver/scene pseudo correct drop <= max(1,ceil(.5% valid)); clean IQ <=DURA+.001; impaired IQ <=1.2*DURA+1e-6; aggregate impaired gain >=10. Threshold .8/.99; separate accuracy-only audit. RX8 excluded.

execution.gpu_policy: GPU0 only; preserve other owners; TF32 disabled
